clientId.title: Home Connect Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 Client ID from a Device Flow application created at https://developer.home-connect.com/applications.

clientSecret.title: Home Connect Client Secret (optional)
clientSecret.description: Only required for confidential clients. Leave empty for Device Flow public clients.

country.title: Server Location
country.description: Use 'China' if you are located within China, otherwise 'Worldwide'.

authorize.title: Authorize with Home Connect
authorize.description: Enable and restart Matterbridge to start the Device Flow. The plugin will log a verification URL — open it, sign in, and approve. The refresh token is then saved automatically.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Saved automatically after authorization. Clear this field and toggle 'Authorize' to re-authorize.

simulator.title: Simulator Mode
simulator.description: Skip the Home Connect cloud API and expose a single demo appliance.

pollIntervalSec.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSec.description: Polling interval for status updates. Minimum 15 seconds.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only appliances in the list will be exposed (match on name or haId).

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: Appliances in the list will not be exposed.
